get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of articles. Unauthenticated requests return only published articles. Authenticated requests can filter by draft status.

post.description: Creates a new article entry in CMS. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a single article by its ID or CUID.

patch.description: Updates an existing article document by ID. Requires authentication.

delete.description: Deletes an article document by ID. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a single city landing page by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a city landing page document by ID. Requires authentication.

patch.description: Updates an existing venue profile document by ID. Requires authentication.
